## Verification

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior
- [ ] Documentation and contracts are updated
- [ ] Versioned artifacts are unchanged or intentionally regenerated under a documented new version
- [ ] Limitation and backlog status accurately reflect what this merge proves
- [ ] No final holdout was accessed, transformed, predicted, or evaluated unless explicitly authorized by the linked issue
- [ ] Inputs are fictional, public, or otherwise clean-room safe
- [ ] No credentials, real customer data, or proprietary material are included
- [ ] Authority boundaries and point-in-time behavior remain explicit

## Evidence

Link test output, examples, experiment notes, or screenshots needed for review.

## Merge readiness

- [ ] Predecessor issues and pull requests are merged
- [ ] Required CI checks pass on the final reviewed commit
- [ ] Review comments are resolved
- [ ] The branch contains no unrelated changes
- [ ] The next dependent branch will start from updated `main`
